descriptionPlain:
At Fullscript, we’re not just shipping wellness products—we’re powering the future of personalized healthcare. As a Warehouse Associate, you’ll play a key role in making sure practitioners and their patients get the support they need, when they need it.
 
Our distribution center team is the backbone of our business. If you’re someone who’s dependable, works well with others, and wants to be part of something bigger—we’d love to meet you.
description:
At Fullscript, we’re not just shipping wellness products—we’re powering the future of personalized healthcare. As a Warehouse Associate, you’ll play a key role in making sure practitioners and their patients get the support they need, when they need it.
 
Our distribution center team is the backbone of our business. If you’re someone who’s dependable, works well with others, and wants to be part of something bigger—we’d love to meet you.

lists.content:
• Receive supplier deliveries 
  • Put away / rotate received product into overstock storage locations 
  • Replenish forward pick locations 
  • Perform inventory cycle counts 
  • Pick/Pack and Ship customer orders in an accurate and timely manner
  • Process customer returns 
  • Maintain a neat and orderly work area, including general maintenance tasks
  • Demonstrate leadership, teamwork, problem solving and a positive professional approach  to work 
  • Perform other duties as assigned

• Good verbal and written communication skills 
  • Interact professionally with associates at all levels 
  • Time management and organization skills 
  • Able to accurately complete productivity and quality documents 
  • Basic computer skills  
  • Ability to meet productivity expectations effectively 
  • Ability to arrive to work on time and adhere to company attendance policies and practices  regarding attendance and time recording 
  • Ability to work varying shifts and days, including overtime as required and occasional  weekends

• 1+ years of work experience 
  • Experience in Distribution Center or manufacturing operations preferred
  • Must be able to comprehend work instructions and documents in English
  • Able to perform in a team environment 
  • Must be able to lift up 0 – 20 lbs. continuously 
  • Must be able to lift up 20 - 40 lbs. frequently 
  • Must be able to lift up 40 - 70 lbs. occasionally 
  • Must be able to work standing continuously for up to 12 hours 
  • Must be able to work bending and reaching continuously for up to 12 hours
  • Must be able to work using 6-8 ft. ladders throughout the work shift
• Work performed primarily in a temperature-controlled distribution center environment.
